description: Near-certain Polymarket outcomes ranked by annualized return to resolution — the "cash-like yield" view of prediction markets.
name: get_prediction_market_yields

available.description: False when this call has no data — a snapshot that is not warm yet, a domain switched off, or an argument that was rejected. NOT an error, and NOT a statement about the market.

fetchedAt.description: When the underlying snapshot was refreshed (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Age matters: these are cached reads, not live queries.

limit.description: Row cap applied to every list in this payload.

minCollateralUsd.description: USD size a ticket had to clear.

priceFloor.description: Entry price a ticket had to clear, 0-1.

reason.description: Why the payload is absent, when `available` is false.

stale.description: True when the snapshot is past its refresh interval.

trades.description: Redemption-arb tickets — near-certain outcomes still trading below $1.

truncated.description: Present only when a list was cut to `limit`.

originalLengths.description: Field name → its full length before the cut.

title: Prediction Market Yield Surface
